assets.name: The Standing Invitation
assets.subject: One oversized mahogany executive desk, long horizontal dark warm wood surface, chunky cream writing pad, a single orange coffee cup and a small dark monitor on a comically tall adjustable stand. Brass-colored details, full wooden modesty panel and stout feet. An empty chair tucked behind it, entirely within the desk assembly. Nobody is standing. No text.
assets.caption: The standing desk has been seated since the procurement meeting.
assets.notes: Shared floor footprint for every colorway; actual authored placements live in start-area/layout.json.

assets.name: The Good Mints
assets.subject: One polished coffee-brown executive credenza on short feet, three small faceted cream/teal acrylic triangle awards on top and a tiny bowl of good mints. Broad dark wood doors, teal inset panel so the palette can be recolored, warm cream top edge. No shiny photographic reflections, no words.
assets.caption: Polished to a mirror shine every Thursday. Holds three crystal triangles and a bowl of good mints.
assets.notes: Shared floor footprint for every colorway; actual authored placements live in start-area/layout.json.

assets.name: Quarter Four's Short Game
assets.subject: One flat private-office miniature putting mat: long horizontal rounded green/teal carpet strip seen from top-down three-quarter angle, cream edging, one little cream practice cup and low automatic ball-return backstop at its right end, one small cream golf ball at left. Keep it FLAT, no flagpole or large upright elements. No outside ground or shadow, no lettering.
assets.caption: The plastic cup returns the ball with a polite whirr. Quarter four is all about the short game.
assets.notes: Floor decor, non-solid. Full caption supplies the joke.

assets.name: Corner Office View
assets.subject: One wide wall-mounted office skyline window in a rich coffee wood and deep navy frame, divided into three panes. Inside the frame only, a simplified navy city skyline of big block buildings and tiny cream square windows against muted teal flat sky. Warm cream frame highlights. No sun rays, gradients or scene outside the window frame. No lettering.
assets.caption: Corner office energy. The view has better work-life balance than anyone in the room.
assets.notes: Wall art, non-solid. Full caption supplies the longer joke.

assets.name: Before Two-Factor
assets.subject: One fictional company founder portrait in a thick coffee-and-cream frame: kindly older mustached gentleman in an old-fashioned suit, very simple broad pixel face, teal painted backdrop, earnest proud expression. Anonymous fictional founder, not a real person. No plaque, names or text.
assets.caption: Painted before two-factor authentication was invented. He looks very proud of us anyway.
assets.notes: Wall art, non-solid. Full caption supplies the longer joke.

assets.name: The Low Seat
assets.subject: One low plush executive visitor armchair with warm brown leather cushions, broad arms, a dark teal inset back, two stout front feet and subtle cream piping. Front/right faces visible. Welcoming, slightly too soft to get out of. One chair only, no sitter or text.
assets.caption: Real leather that sinks three inches lower than you expect. Standing back up is a team-building exercise.
assets.notes: Shared floor footprint for every colorway; actual authored placements live in start-area/layout.json.

assets.name: Synergy, Apparently
assets.subject: One chunky cream acrylic star-shaped award on a thick TEAL plinth, small warm orange facet accent. The entire object fits a tiny office trophy silhouette, no lettering on the plinth. Broad simple pixels, no glass transparency, no sparkles or shadow.
assets.caption: Heavy acrylic stars for synergies nobody quite remembers. They catch the afternoon light nicely.
assets.notes: Tabletop detail, non-solid. Place above its host table.
